definitions.explanation: A licensed professional who handles tax-related matters including tax filing, tax planning, and representation before tax authorities. Requires passing a national examination.

examples.japanese: {確定申告|かくていしんこく}を{税理士|ぜいりし}に{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I asked a tax accountant to handle my tax return.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{顧問|こもん}{税理士|ぜいりし}と{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I consulted with the company's tax advisor.

examples.japanese: {税理士|ぜいりし}{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}するのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to pass the tax accountant examination.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{税|ぜい} (tax) + {理|り} (manage) + {士|し} (professional/samurai)

LICENSING:
{税理士|ぜいりし} is a national qualification in Japan requiring:
・Passing the {税理士|ぜいりし}{試験|しけん} (5 subjects)
・2+ years of practical experience
・Registration with the {日本|にほん}{税理士|ぜいりし}{会連合会|かいれんごうかい}

SCOPE OF WORK:
・{確定申告|かくていしんこく} (tax return filing)
・{税務|ぜいむ}{相談|そうだん} (tax consultation)
・{税務|ぜいむ}{代理|だいり} (representation before tax office)
・{会計|かいけい}{業務|ぎょうむ} (accounting services)

RELATED PROFESSIONS:
・{公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし} (CPA - certified public accountant)
・{司法書士|しほうしょし} (judicial scrivener)
・{行政書士|ぎょうせいしょし} (administrative scrivener)
・{弁護士|べんごし} (lawyer)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{税理士|ぜいりし}に{相談|そうだん}する (to consult a tax accountant)
・{税理士|ぜいりし}{事務所|じむしょ} (tax accounting firm)
・{顧問|こもん}{税理士|ぜいりし} (tax advisor - retainer basis)
・{税理士|ぜいりし}{報酬|ほうしゅう} (tax accountant fees)
